[SWS_DM_00896] Handling of DiagnosticClearConditions
⌈
If any
of the clear conditions mapped to the DTC to be cleared are not fulfilled by a
call of the function SetCondition() from an ara::diag::Condition instance
([SWS_DM_00715]) with the value kConditionFalse ([SWS_DM_00710]), the clear
is forbidden. Otherwise (all of the clear conditions mapped to the DTC are fulfilled) the
clear is allowed.
⌋
